title: C++ Introduction
description: Where C++ came from, what it is designed for, and how the ISO standard shapes the language, from C++98 to C++20.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: C++ 的起源、設計目標，以及 ISO 標準如何形塑這門語言：由 C++98 到 C++20。

questions.prompt: Who created C++, and where was it developed?

prompt.zh-Hant: 誰發明了 C++？它是在哪裡開發的？

a.zh-Hant: Bjarne Stroustrup 在貝爾實驗室

b.zh-Hant: Dennis Ritchie 在貝爾實驗室

d.zh-Hant: Guido van Rossum 在荷蘭數學與電腦科學研究中心

explanation.zh-Hant: Bjarne Stroustrup 於 1979 年在 AT&T 貝爾實驗室開始開發 C++。Dennis Ritchie 發明 C，James Gosling 發明 Java，Guido van Rossum 發明 Python。

questions.explanation: Bjarne Stroustrup began C++ at AT&T Bell Labs in 1979. Dennis Ritchie created C, James Gosling created Java, and Guido van Rossum created Python.

questions.prompt: What was C++ called before it was given the name C++?

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 在被命名為 C++ 之前叫甚麼？

a.zh-Hant: C with Classes（帶類別的 C）

explanation.zh-Hant: Stroustrup 的專案原名 “C with Classes”，1983 年才改名 C++。Objective-C 是 Brad Cox 的另一門語言，ANSI C 則是 C 的標準。

questions.explanation: Stroustrup's project was called "C with Classes" and was renamed C++ in 1983. Objective-C is a separate language by Brad Cox, and ANSI C is a C standard.

questions.prompt: C++ is a strict superset of C, so every valid C program is also a valid C++ program.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 是 C 的嚴格超集，因此每一份合法的 C 程式也都是合法的 C++ 程式。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++ 大致相容 C 原始碼，但不是嚴格超集：例如 C++ 不會把 void* 隱式轉成 T*，而 class、new 等識別字在 C++ 是關鍵字，在 C 卻可以當一般名稱。

questions.explanation: C++ is largely source-compatible with C but not a strict superset: void* does not convert implicitly to T*, and identifiers such as class and new are keywords in C++ but ordinary names in C.

questions.prompt: A conforming C++ compiler must emit exactly the machine instructions prescribed by the ISO standard.

prompt.zh-Hant: 符合標準的 C++ 編譯器必須產生 ISO 標準所規定的確切機器指令。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標準規定的是可觀察行為，不是程式碼產生方式；在 as-if 規則下，只要可觀察行為不變，編譯器可以自由最佳化。

questions.explanation: The standard prescribes observable behaviour, not code generation. Under the as-if rule a compiler may optimise freely as long as the program's observable behaviour is unchanged.

questions.prompt: Which of these are published ISO C++ standards? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是已發佈的 ISO C++ 標準？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++98、C++11、C++17 都是 ISO 標準（其後還有 C++03、C++14、C++20、C++23）。並沒有 C++09：該版本延期，最後以 C++11 發佈。

questions.explanation: C++98, C++11 and C++17 are ISO standards (C++03, C++14, C++20 and C++23 followed). There is no C++09: that work slipped and was published as C++11.

questions.prompt: Which programming styles does C++ support directly? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 直接支援下列哪些程式設計風格？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 以自由函式進行的程序式程式設計

b.zh-Hant: 以類別與虛擬函式進行的物件導向程式設計

c.zh-Hant: 以樣板進行的泛型程式設計

d.zh-Hant: 由語言強制提供、完全不必手動管理的垃圾回收

explanation.zh-Hant: C++ 是多範式語言：程序式、物件導向、泛型與函式風格可以並存。語言仍保留 new/delete 手動記憶體管理，也不強制要求垃圾回收。

options.text: Object-oriented programming with classes and virtual functions
Mandatory garbage collection with no manual memory management

questions.explanation: C++ is multi-paradigm: procedural, object-oriented, generic and functional styles coexist. Manual memory management with new and delete remains, and the language does not require a garbage collector.

questions.prompt: Which statement describes the C++ design principle known as "zero-overhead abstraction"?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一句話描述了 C++ 的「零開銷抽象」設計原則？

a.zh-Hant: 高階功能應編譯成與手寫低階程式碼同樣有效率的機器碼，而沒用到的功能不應付出成本。

b.zh-Hant: 每一種抽象都必須付出少量執行期成本，以換取可讀性。

c.zh-Hant: 程式必須避免類別與樣板，才能保持效能。

d.zh-Hant: 編譯器會移除所有執行期檢查，包括你自己寫的檢查。

explanation.zh-Hant: Stroustrup 的原則是「不需為沒用到的東西付出成本，用到的部分要和手寫程式碼一樣好」。它是設計準則，不是讓編譯器刪掉你自己寫的檢查。

options.text: Higher-level features should compile to code as efficient as hand-written low-level code, and unused features should cost nothing.
Every abstraction must pay a small run-time fee that is acceptable for readability.
Programs must avoid classes and templates to stay fast.
The compiler removes all run-time checks, including checks you write yourself.

questions.explanation: Stroustrup's rule is that you do not pay for what you do not use, and what you do use should be as good as hand-written code. It is a design guideline, not a licence to delete your own checks.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes where C++ is commonly used?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一句最能描述 C++ 常見的應用領域？

a.zh-Hant: 效能關鍵的軟體，例如遊戲引擎、瀏覽器、資料庫與嵌入式韌體。

b.zh-Hant: 主要用於網頁的樣式與版面配置。

c.zh-Hant: 只用於入門程式設計課程。

d.zh-Hant: 只用於短的自動化腳本。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++ 的典型領域是需要直接控制記憶體與效能的地方：遊戲引擎、瀏覽器、資料庫、交易系統、嵌入式與高效能運算。

options.text: Performance-critical software such as game engines, browsers, databases and embedded firmware.
Mainly for styling and layout of web pages.

questions.explanation: C++ is used where control over memory and performance matters: game engines, browsers, databases, trading systems, embedded firmware and high-performance computing.

questions.prompt: The first ISO C++ standard, usually called C++98, was published in the year ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 第一個 ISO C++ 標準（通稱 C++98）於 ____ 年發佈。

explanation.zh-Hant: ISO/IEC 14882:1998 是第一個標準化的 C++，因此通稱 C++98。

questions.explanation: ISO/IEC 14882:1998 was the first standardised C++, which is why it is called C++98.

questions.prompt: In one or two sentences, explain why C++ is described as a multi-paradigm language.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用一至兩句說明為甚麼 C++ 被稱為多範式語言。

model.zh-Hant: C++ 允許在同一個程式庫中混合程序式程式碼、類別與繼承、樣板，以及函式風格的演算法，因此問題的每個部分都能採用最合適的風格，而不必被單一範式綁死。

explanation.zh-Hant: 重點在於「可以混用」：語言刻意同時支援多種風格，而不是強制只用一種。

answer.model: C++ lets one codebase mix procedural code, classes and inheritance, templates and functional-style algorithms, so each part of a problem can use the style that fits it instead of being forced into a single paradigm.

questions.explanation: The key point is that the styles can be mixed: the language deliberately supports several at once instead of enforcing one.
